body: Action was brought to determine whether California Energy Resources Conservation and Development Commission could exercise certification jurisdiction over electrical power plant repowering project. The Superior Court, Los Angeles County, No. BS003230, John Zebrowski, J., ordered issuance of preemptory writ of mandate commanding Commission to cease its exercise of such certification jurisdiction, and Commission appealed.
